title: Python decode_cose: envelope-level framing leniency diverges from Rust byte-strict parser (long-form heads, extended protected header accepted)
description: Codereview finding on 5rfl (reviewer kimi-k3 security pass, empirically PoC-confirmed). The 5rfl byte-equality gate closes the payload-map level, but SlotClaim.decode_cose still parses the COSE envelope with lenient cbor2.loads and only checks header.get(1) == -65537 (slot_claim.py:273-era), while Rust from_cose is byte-strict (slot.rs:524-545): exact 0x84 array head, protected byte-equal to the shared PROTECTED constant, exact 0xa1/uint 4 unprotected framing, minimal bstr heads via Reader::head minimality, finished() on the envelope. Empirically Python accepts and verify_slot_claim signature-validates (it digests re-encoded constants): long-form array head 98 04, long-form payload/signature bstr heads (59 xx xx), non-0xa1 unprotected head, protected headers carrying extra entries (e.g. {1: -65537, 2: h'78'}). Rust rejects every one as MalformedClaim/UnsupportedAlgorithm, so the cheapest malleation (flip one head byte) still splits Python vs Rust verdicts on signature-valid claims. Fix direction: give decode_cose the same strict-form treatment — byte-exact array/unprotected heads, byte-exact (or canonical-re-encode-compared) protected header, minimal bstr heads — or file the cross-impl adjudication if exact-byte protected-header equality is judged too strict for Python. Pre-existing paths (not introduced by 5rfl); severity P2 same class as 5rfl itself.
close_reason: Strict-form COSE envelope parsing was already implemented and committed (decode_cose uses exact 0x84 head, _STRICT_PROTECTED byte-compare, minimal-head _read_head/_read_bstr, unprotected {4: kid}, no trailing bytes). All 122 tests in tests/gateway/test_slot_claim.py + test_slot_claim_cose_vectors.py pass, including the 33vn malleation suite (long-form array/bstr heads, non-minimal uint, extra protected entries). Delegated reviewer pass (kimi-k3, correctness) cross-checked Python against Rust slot.rs:530-554 + tunnel_auth.rs Reader::head semantics point-by-point: PASS, no findings. No code changes this round; fix pre-existed uncommitted-work-free in tree.
